newsitem.title: UK: Flextech, BBC give BSkyB group 1st digital option.
newsitem.headline: Flextech, BBC give BSkyB group 1st digital option.

text.p: UK broadcaster Flextech Plc and its pay-television channel partner BBC Worldwide Ltd will give the first option for digital terrestrial transmission to BSkyB 's consortium.
Announcing details of two joint ventures with BBC Worldwide, Flextech confirmed on Monday that the first option on up to five of the joint venture channels would go to British Digital Broadcasting.
British Digital Broadcasting is the consortium comprising Carlton Communications Plc, Granada Group Plc and British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc.
The group has bid for licences to operate up to three "multiplexes", multi-channel digital frequencies, from UK broadcasting regulator, the ITC.
